title: Chapter 306 Mysterious Bronze Palace
content:
Chapter 306 Mysterious Bronze Palace

At this time, in the ancient battlefield of the fairy world.

As the giant slowly dissipated, Lu Xue and his group finally breathed a sigh of relief.

"Young master, it doesn't matter."

Ao Qing looked at Lu Xue who was silent at this moment, a little worried.

The same is true for Xiao Luo and Qin Feng on the side.

Lu Xue's condition is obviously wrong at this moment.

Since waking up, I have become taciturn, which is not like Lu Xue.

Could it be that it was hit?

At this time, Lu Xue shook her head slightly, but she was still in a low mood.

This is the first time she has been beaten so badly.

If it were in the past, my father would have come directly and pushed everything out.

But now, until I woke up, there was no trace of my father.

She knew that my dad really didn't care about her this time.

well.

Lu Xue sighed slightly, not knowing whether it was because of her weakness or because Lu Daosheng really ignored her.

"By the way, where is that giant?"

Lu Xue came to her senses and asked suddenly.

Hearing this, both of them shook their heads, "When we react, the giant will disappear."

They didn't know about Lu Xue's huge sword cutting off.

Hearing the two of them say this, Lu Xue was confused, but she didn't ask any more questions.

Anyway, it's fine now.

Soon, Lu Xue recovered from her injuries and became lively and jumped around again.

At this moment, she felt vaguely that she was about to break through. I think it should be because of that giant.

It seems that the decision to stay on the ancient battlefield was indeed correct.

"Sister Xue, what should we do now?"

Xiao Luo looked at Lu Xue and asked.

Of course, I still obey Lu Xue's whereabouts.

Hearing this, Lu Xue only pondered for a moment and pointed in a direction.

"Go over there."

There is no doubt that he is just intuition.

Who made her a person of destiny?

Immediately, the few people set out on the itinerary again and rushed towards the direction Lu Xue pointed.

Along the way, the few people were surprisingly not in danger.

I don’t know how long it took, a magnificent building appeared in the sight of several people.

It seemed to be a dilapidated palace, covered with traces of time, and it still stands here after endless years.

As they got closer and closer to the palace, Lu Xue and others suddenly discovered that there were sparse people around the palace at this moment, as if they were waiting for something.

In response, Lu Xue immediately put forward a gesture.

Seeing this, the two of them quickly stopped.

Lu Xue said solemnly: "At this moment, the ancient battlefield is full of crises, and those who dare to stay in the ancient battlefield are definitely not ordinary people."

In other words, these people are not simple.

Hearing Lu Xue's words, Qin Feng and the others nodded slightly and agreed.

Xiao Luo said, "Sister Xue, why not let me test who these are."

Hearing this, Lu Xue pondered for a moment, and finally nodded.

It is most suitable to go by Xiao Luo.

After all, Xiao Luo is also a member of the Xiao clan. Unless these are people from the Ye clan or the Chu clan, Xiao Luo is likely to be fine.

Being an enemy of the Xiao clan is not a wise move.

Then Xiao Luo stepped forward directly.

"Who?!"

When one of the men with a fierce expression yelled angrily when he noticed Xiao Luo's approaching.

"Everyone, I am Xiao Luo, a member of the Xiao clan."

As soon as he came up, Xiao Luo generously reported his name.

"Xiao Luo?"

Another man with a slightly pale face looked at Xiao Luo, then smiled faintly and said, "Are you Xiao Luo, who is known as the number one in the younger generation of the Xiao clan now?"

I don't know if this is ridiculous.

After all, how terrifying the Xiao clan is now, the entire fairyland is well known.

But the number one person in the younger generation of Xiao clan has just entered the Immortal Emperor realm, and the gap is a bit big.

But when he heard this, Xiao Luo just smiled and said, "Yes, it's just right."

"Is there anything wrong?"

The man restrained his smile and said indifferently.

In his eyes, he was obviously a little afraid.

Of course, the other party was naturally not afraid of Xiao Luo, but the Xiao clan behind Xiao Luo.

Hearing this, Xiao Luo smiled slightly, then looked at the bronze palace in front of him.

A feeling of vicissitudes of time suddenly came to my mind.

"Do you know this bronze palace?"

"Nothing to be told."

As soon as he finished speaking, a man closest to the Bronze Palace suddenly spoke.

The others were silent.

Obviously, the man was the leader of these people.

Xiao Luo looked at the man and saw that he was wearing a dark green gown, his face was thin and his eyes were deep.

He was holding a silver spear in his hand, looking indifferently at the bronze palace in front of him.

He didn't even look at Xiao Luo.

"Who is this?"

Xiao Luo asked tentatively.

There were five people in total, all of whom were the aura of the Immortal Emperor Realm, which made Xiao Luo a little shocked.

Especially the man with a spear, his breath was even more unfathomable.

"My elder brother, Chen Mingyu."

The man with a fierce face said straight, with a hint of pride in his eyes.

At this moment, Xiao Luo was shocked.

It turned out to be him!

As early as when she saw the silver spear, Xiao Luo had some guesses in his heart.

But unexpectedly, he actually entered the ancient battlefield.

No. 19th place in the Demon List, Gun God Chen Mingyu!

A silver spear has long been famous in the fairy world.

Chen Mingyu is obviously not a student of Tiandi Academy, so it is unknown why he did not join.

After all, not any genius monster will choose to join the Tiandi Academy.

"Looking for a long time."

Xiao Luo hugged Chen Mingyu in the distance, showing his respect.

With his identity, Chen Mingyu is extremely proud of his face.

However, Chen Mingyu did not react at all to this.

He didn't even look at Xiao Luo.

This made Xiao Luo feel a little angry.

"Young Master Xiao, please leave, we still have something to do."

The man with a slightly pale face smiled again.

If it were someone else, they would have killed him long ago. It’s a pity that the Xiao clan behind Xiao Luo was really terrifying.

They can't afford to bet.

Xiao Luo stood there, looked at Chen Mingyu in the distance deeply, and finally left here.

"The Xiao family has a great career, but it is just a genius in the family, tsk."

There is also one woman among the five, who is very charming and wearing a cheongsam, which fully demonstrates her concave and convex figure.

But the man present did not dare to take a look.

"Sister Qingshui, it's wrong for you to say that. You won't forget that the demons of the Xiao clan suppressed the horror of an era million years ago."

Hearing this, Luo Qingshui snorted coldly and said, "The Xiao clan has produced Xiao Yin, which has probably consumed all the luck of the entire family. I don't believe that he can produce another one."

Hearing this, the rest of the people stopped saying anything.

It is really incredible to have another Xiao Yin come out.

“Get ready.”

At this moment, Chen Mingyu, who had been silent, suddenly spoke.

Suddenly, the other four people quickly looked alert.
